title: Transforms
comment: Move it, turn it, tile it, mirror it: one shape (a square with a circle at
its corner) through move, rotate, tile, mirror, kaleidoscope and warp, the
original ghosted in grey behind each result. Each result is the very
expression on screen, applied to the whole canvas and placed in its frame.

sections.name: the hook
sections.label: transforms
sections.say: Move it, turn it, tile it, mirror it.
stage: let hk1 = text("04  ·  transforms", x: 0.5, y: 0.74, size: 0.036, font: "mono") * (T >= 3.3)
let hk2 = text("alea, one feature at a time", x: 0.5, y: 0.81, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= 3.3)
let hookf = max(wave * RED, max(hk1 * INK, hk2 * GREY))

sections.name: move: a tenth right, a tenth down
sections.label: move
sections.say: Move it: a tenth to the right, a tenth down.

sections.name: rotate: thirty degrees around the centre
sections.label: rotate
sections.say: Turn it: thirty degrees, around the centre.

sections.name: tile: the whole canvas, three by three
sections.label: tile
sections.say: Tile it: the whole canvas, three by three.

sections.name: kaleidoscope: one wedge, mirrored eight times
sections.label: kaleidoscope
sections.say: A kaleidoscope: the turned one, mirrored eight times around.

sections.name: warp: the space bent; they all combine
sections.label: warp
sections.say: And warp bends the space itself. They all combine.

sections.name: the end
sections.say: Next week: time. Add t, and the picture starts to move.
stage: let name2 = text("alea", x: nx0e, y: 0.72, size: nsize, font: "mono", align: "left") * (T >= 55.6)
let ecur = (abs(x - (nx0e + 4.5 * nadv)) < nadv * 0.42) * (abs(y - 0.72) < nsize * 0.4) * blink * (T >= 55.6)
let e1 = text("one feature at a time  ·  04  ·  transforms", x: 0.5, y: 0.86, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= 56.1)
let e2 = text("alea.bngz.io", x: 0.5, y: 0.97, size: 0.06, font: "mono") * (T >= 56.6)
let e3 = text("next  ·  05  ·  time", x: 0.5, y: 1.10, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= l8.words[2])
let e4 = text("open source  ·  github.com/sudo-bngz/alea", x: 0.5, y: 1.18, size: 0.026, font: "mono") * (T >= 57.8)
let endf = max(k8_code, max(name2 * INK, max(ecur * RED, max(e1 * INK, max(e2 * RED, max(e3 * GREY, e4 * INK))))))

overlays.paint: place(paint(max(s * 0.4, r_move), palette: ink, range: [0, 1]), x: 0.5, y: 0.95, width: 0.36, height: 0.64)
place(paint(max(s * 0.4, r_rot), palette: ink, range: [0, 1]), x: 0.5, y: 0.95, width: 0.36, height: 0.64)
place(paint(max(s * 0.4, r_tile), palette: ink, range: [0, 1]), x: 0.5, y: 0.95, width: 0.36, height: 0.64)
place(paint(max(s * 0.4, r_mir), palette: ink, range: [0, 1]), x: 0.5, y: 0.95, width: 0.36, height: 0.64)
place(paint(max(s * 0.4, r_kal), palette: ink, range: [0, 1]), x: 0.5, y: 0.95, width: 0.36, height: 0.64)
place(paint(max(s * 0.4, r_warp), palette: ink, range: [0, 1]), x: 0.5, y: 0.95, width: 0.36, height: 0.64)
